verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a remote-access tool like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows TeamViewer publishing its source or releasing it under an open license. The evidence describes paid licensing and trials, and community users seek open-source alternatives instead.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
